evidence_driven_design_risks.risk: Syntactically valid or true standalone answers can be attached to the wrong method/question.
evidence_driven_design_risks.future_pilot_requirement: Measure semantic question-to-fact association, not just JSON/ID validity. Permute labels/order on authorized future examples; hold out matched facts under changed labels.

evidence_driven_design_risks.risk: Verifier labels can disagree with their own reason and source.
evidence_driven_design_risks.future_pilot_requirement: Score complete label+grounded reason+source-link+bilingual record, separately from labels. Do not teach universal truth certification.

evidence_driven_design_risks.risk: Source syntax does not imply application/runtime guarantees.
evidence_driven_design_risks.future_pilot_requirement: Targets explicitly distinguish source statement, controlled observation and unverified integration. No training on current evaluation-only examples.

data_proposal_not_dataset_creation.required_gold_state: Every target separately owner-approved for training, with rights/source lineage and bilingual review
data_proposal_not_dataset_creation.future_independent_evaluation: Reserve fresh authorized source families/tasks and freeze owner-reviewed reference before any pilot tuning. Current OpenRA metadata reserve is not an approved pilot split or pretraining holdout certification.

baseline_requirement: Use the same verified trainable checkpoint/tokenizer/framework/precision for base versus adapter comparison. Existing Q4GGUF local responses are diagnostic context, not a matched causal fine-tuning baseline.

unchanged_execution_bounds.exact_target_module_paths: UNRESOLVED until compatible trainable base is verified; no permissive fallback

success_proposal.primary: At least one complete held-out documentation/FAQ task accepted under unchanged source and bilingual criteria, while outperforming matched-base complete acceptance on a frozen owner-approved evaluation set.
nonregression: No increase in critical unsupported guarantees, unsafe removals, identifier drift or wrong-method answer links.
Report exact numerators/denominators, source-family grouping, uncertainty and all failures.
Do not infer general accuracy or an independent truth verifier from a tiny pilot.
success_proposal.if_baseline_already_accepts_all: Do not claim learning from tied acceptance; require a measurable pre-frozen improvement dimension or report inconclusive.

preservation_and_rollback: Keep original trainable base/tokenizer hashes immutable, archive step0/adapter/checkpoint/config/RNG/input/reference/result hashes and restore verification. Existing serving GGUF and current datasets remain untouched.
readiness_blockers: No measured training peak/free unified memory
No approved independent pilot split or exact target-module inspection
